exact_read: Introductory field/Gamma/c-polytope conventions, Theorem3.2 full statement and proof3.2.1-3.2.3, theorem3.4 comparison
applicability: Take Gamma={1} and a compact strict curve moment domain over nontrivially valued K (or finite E). Its actual analytic structure may be nonreduced: source reduction is confined to this topological image theorem. Full proof reduces to algebraic affinoid pieces then applies definability; no quasi-smoothness assumption on original curve. Dimension upper bound only; constant moments can have dimension zero.
